1925, December
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 1.
Page 28 Cont.
Her mother tells us now that the last few convulsions she had be- fore they gave her the hypdarmimics, seemed to give her great joy. She would come out ot them smiling and laughing, and asked the cause of her happiness, would answer, "0 Mother! you know I want to be a saint." ..
Jan. 3 Funeral to-day - about 26 priests & 2 Monsg. present. Bishop Gallagher gave Ben.
Dec. 6 Wonderful !! Lives Without Eating. Robert E. Morissey 7, of 1409 cavalry Ave. (Detroit) burned by swallowing potash when 52 - Sept. 6th 1923 - has never swallowed since, except once when thought dy- ing he swallowed Holy Viaticum - his First Communion. This was after one of the 30 operations he has had in a year and 6 months. Same R. E. M. nourishes himself now by masticating it first and then emitting it through a tube into the front of abdomen. . .... Today at Monastery seems "picture of health" and innocently mis- chievous enough too - Hopes to be a priest some day. Please God, we'll hope with him.
Dec. 19th Thanks be to God. Same Robert E.M. comes To-day again able to eat anything.
Dec. 8th Mrs. Francis Howard 63 of 1316 Ferdinand Ave. run down by Auto July 23. in hospital 11 weeks and doing poorly: is enrolled Nov 17th -- Gets up and walks No. 21st to surprise of all. Thanks be to God.
Page 29 Dec. 16 Reconciliation! Is It Hopeless? - No. Melvin Wood 39, Royal Oak, divorced from Wife and 5 children for near a year is enrolled To- day in S.M. A. by brokenhearted Wife - She fears for his soul and loss of family property. Has tried in vain to come to some kind of understanding. We'll thank God now for the speedy reconcilia- tion we hope for. Praised be God!
